intro.en: Coaxial cable assemblies preserve controlled impedance through the cable, connector and every transition.
intro.zh: 同轴电缆组件在电缆、连接器与每一处过渡中维持受控阻抗。

knowledge.en: System impedance, frequency, loss, power, cable construction, connector interface, termination and validation must be defined together.
knowledge.zh: 系统阻抗、频率、损耗、功率、线缆结构、连接器界面、端接与验证必须共同定义。

notes.en: Provide equipment ports, impedance, frequency band, signal or power, length, cable limits, route, environment and test evidence.
notes.zh: 请提供设备端口、阻抗、频段、信号或功率、长度、线缆限制、路径、环境与测试证据。

delivery.en: Release records cable and connector part numbers, impedance, length, strip and termination controls, labels, environment and agreed electrical evidence.
delivery.zh: 放行记录包含线缆与连接器料号、阻抗、长度、剥线和端接控制、标签、环境及约定电气证据。

subtitle.en: Preserve impedance through every cable, connector and transition
subtitle.zh: 让阻抗控制贯穿线缆、连接器与每一处过渡

lead.en: Define the complete RF, video or instrumentation channel before selecting cable and termination.
lead.zh: 先定义完整射频、视频或仪器通道，再选择线缆与端接方式。
